subject: Bluecrest POC — initial credits & throughput adjustment
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@bluecrest.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial request — expanded context & throughput for POC

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding. Our POC starts next week and the scope changed after we added longer document indexing and live summarization. Two things that are blocking our test runs:

- Context horizon: we need a 100k-token working context for a small set of documents (batch eval).
- Throughput: expected peak traffic during scripted evaluation is ~15k TPM for a 48‑72 hour window.

The self-serve trial is great, but it spins up throttles before we can finish the end-to-end run. Can Redwood temporarily increase the initial trial credit bucket and a short-term throughput cap so we can complete the evaluation?

Suggested ask: $7,500 in trial credits and a temporary throughput bump to 20k TPM for up to 14 days. We can restrict traffic to specific endpoints and provide a short mutual action plan.

I attached a 2‑page summary of the POC scope (bluecrest-poc-scope.pdf).

Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the evaluation details.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of ML — Bluecrest AI
amit@bluecrest.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Folks — forwarding request from Bluecrest (Amit). Customer is in HB pipeline; HubSpot link below. Key asks: 100k token context, $7.5k trial credit, short-term 20k TPM bump for up to 14 days. They say they will limit to specific endpoints and can sign an amendment.

Why I’m asking:
- This is an engineering-heavy POC; if we don’t allow the run they will stall the evaluation and likely revert to a competitor.
- We can mitigate risk with a short-term throughput cap and by keeping the trial quota isolated to the HB dev project.

Questions for approval:
1) Approve $7,500 in trial credits?
2) Approve temporary throughput cap of 20k TPM for 14 days?
3) Do we require a DocuSign amendment or is a signed email adequate?

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/bluecrest-ai
Attached: customer scope pdf.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial request — expanded context & throughput for POC

Ben — reviewed the scope and budget impact. Approve as follows:

- Trial credit issuance: $7,500 (applied to the account as an upfront credit pool).
- Throughput: temporary cap increase to 20k TPM for 14 calendar days from activation. After 14 days, throttle back to standard trial caps unless we move to a paid contract.
- Trial duration: extend evaluation window to 60 days from initial activation to accommodate the long-run metrics collection.
- Compliance: require customer to confirm in email that they will not share production traffic during the trial and will restrict to named endpoints. No additional SOC artifacts required for this short-term accommodation.

Action items for Ben:
- Apply credit via internal billing flow and record in HubSpot (leave a note with the grant id).
- Send an email to Amit with the amendment attachment and the activation steps.

I attached a template amendment (redwood-trial-amendment.pdf). PRiyom, please confirm the billing note and the grant id once applied.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

Amit — good news: we approved the request. Summary below and next steps.

What we issued:
- Trial credit: $7,500 applied as an account-level credit pool.
- Throughput: temporary increase to 20,000 TPM for 14 days starting when you tell us you are ready to flip it on.
- Trial window: extended to 60 days from the date you activate the grant.

Attachments: grant-confirmation.txt (contains grant id and internal reference), and the amendment PDF Marissa mentioned.

Please reply to confirm you accept the temporary conditions (restrict traffic to the named endpoints and limit production-like traffic). Once you confirm, I’ll activate the grant and send the activation timestamp + HubSpot note.

Next steps:
- If you want an onboarding sync around warmup and caching suggestions, I can schedule a 30-minute session with our infra team this week.
- We’ll monitor the trial (token burn, latency) and can pause the throughput bump if there are unexpected spikes.
